people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Joshua
people.line: Moses' assistant who led Israel into Canaan

translations.web: Joshua and all Israel made as if they were beaten before them, and fled by the way of the wilderness.
translations.bsb: Joshua and all Israel let themselves be beaten back before them, and they fled toward the wilderness.
translations.kjv: And Joshua and all Israel made as if they were beaten before them, and fled by the way of the wilderness.
translations.asv: And Joshua and all Israel made as if they were beaten before them, and fled by the way of the wilderness.
